item.title: Crash Due to Traffic Queues (Temporary Lights Issue), 21st October
item.description:
Due to the hopelessness of the "temporary" lights, queing traffic blocked the view for a driver turning right from the old Volkswagen site onto runnings road (eastbound). As they emerged through the westbound queue they hit a motorcyclist travelling eastbound. Traffic flows much better when the temporary lights are not working, improving visibilty for merging traffic. Queuing traffic is also causes a pollution issue. Street lighting is also not working, possibly due to the same mains fault reported on the permanent lights. This makes it hazardous for pedestrians, especially in the longer hours of darkness. The traffic light problem needs resolving NOW before more incidents occur.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Manor Road, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
